title: Binance Options Will Launch BNBUSDT and SOLUSDT Monthly Options
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance Options will launch BNBUSDT and SOLUSDT Monthly Options at  2024-11-26   08:00 (UTC) .   Please note:   BNBUSDT and SOLUSDT Monthly Options are European-style options contracts. Please refer to  Binance Options Contract Specifications  for more details.  There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2024-11-25
